verdict.rationale: Graphite's docs say AI reviews suggest fixes that can be applied in one click from the review page. Its Agent can make direct code changes from the PR page, and those changes are committed to the branch as normal PR commits, which covers both the committed-patch and agent-generated follow-up paths without leaving the PR. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that findings-to-fix works as documented.

support.subject: As a developer, I turn a review finding into an applied fix — a committed patch or an agent-generated follow-up — without leaving the PR

citations.quote: Ask for suggested fixes and apply them in one click right from the review page.
Make direct code changes right from your PR page. Click Agent on the right side of the PR to get started.
Any changes made by the agent are committed directly to the branch and appear in the PR like any other commit.
identifying potential issues and suggesting fixes instantly
Graphite Chat integrates directly with GitHub where you can take suggestions in 1-click. No context switching needed.
